name: Zenith Divine Wave
name_jp: 究極ディバインウェーブ
effects: Seven single hybrid attacks (3.05/3.10 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking] if entry damage was Holy/Water, [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Arc (Holy)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (3.05/3.10 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking] if entry damage was Holy/Water, [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Arc (Holy)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Arc (Holy)
description.text: Increases [Water/Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Water or Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Arc after using two Water or Holy abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Auroral Leviath+
description.text: Five single hybrid attacks (3.87/4.02 or 5.25/5.40 each), minimum damage 2000 (SUM only), capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Grace of Water+
description.text: Four single attacks (5.25 each), minimum damage 2000, grants [Buff Holy 10% (15s)] and [Buff Water 10% (15s)] to all allies every third activation, capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Attach Holy 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Water 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
